name: Black-legged kittiwake
desc: A surface-feeding gull that eats fish such as capelin, herring and sand lance in the Gulf of Alaska.
about: The black-legged kittiwake is a seabird species in the gull family Laridae. This species was first described by Carl Linnaeus in his landmark 1758 10th edition of Systema Naturae as Larus tridactylus.
